sourceNote: Local interpretation atlas inspired by standard natal astrology structures. The app calculates actual apparent Sun, Moon, and planet positions with astronomy-engine, then maps those positions to these text entries.

Aries.summary: Aries placements describe a personality that learns by entering the arena. You tend to meet life directly, prefer momentum over overthinking, and feel most alive when there is a clear challenge.
Aries.gift: Courage, initiative, and the ability to wake other people up.
Aries.watch: Impatience can make a temporary obstacle feel like a permanent wall.

Taurus.summary: Taurus placements describe a personality that trusts what can be built, touched, and sustained. You often move at your own pace and become powerful through consistency.
Taurus.gift: Endurance, taste, and a calming ability to make ideas real.
Taurus.watch: Comfort can become a cage when change is treated as betrayal.

Gemini.summary: Gemini placements describe a personality that metabolizes life through questions, language, and pattern-spotting. You need movement of mind and room to connect unlike things.
Gemini.gift: Mental agility, humor, and the ability to translate between worlds.
Gemini.watch: Too many open tabs, literal or emotional, can scatter your force.

Cancer.summary: Cancer placements describe a personality tuned to belonging, memory, and emotional weather. You often sense what a room needs before anyone says it aloud.
Cancer.gift: Care, emotional intelligence, and fierce devotion.
Cancer.watch: Self-protection can turn into withdrawal when a direct ask would work better.

Leo.summary: Leo placements describe a personality that needs to create, radiate, and stand behind something with heart. You are restored by honest appreciation and meaningful play.
Leo.gift: Generosity, presence, and the courage to be seen.
Leo.watch: Pride can make repair harder than it needs to be.

Virgo.summary: Virgo placements describe a personality that improves life through attention. You notice what is out of tune and often show care by refining, organizing, or healing it.
Virgo.gift: Craft, usefulness, and devotion to getting the details right.
Virgo.watch: The wish to improve everything can blur into self-criticism.

Libra.summary: Libra placements describe a personality that seeks proportion, beauty, and mutuality. You are built to notice imbalance and often bring grace to complex social spaces.
Libra.gift: Diplomacy, charm, and an instinct for humane design.
Libra.watch: Keeping the peace can become self-erasure when your own preference matters.

Scorpio.summary: Scorpio placements describe a personality drawn to depth, truth, and hidden motives. You rarely accept the surface version when you can feel the current underneath.
Scorpio.gift: Emotional courage, focus, and the capacity to regenerate.
Scorpio.watch: Testing trust can become a habit even when trust has already been earned.

Sagittarius.summary: Sagittarius placements describe a personality that needs meaning, horizon, and honest movement. You grow by following the big question farther than comfort allows.
Sagittarius.gift: Optimism, candor, and the ability to make life feel larger.
Sagittarius.watch: Freedom can become avoidance when commitment is the actual adventure.

Capricorn.summary: Capricorn placements describe a personality that respects time, mastery, and earned authority. You are often at your best when building something that can outlast a mood.
Capricorn.gift: Discipline, strategy, and reliability under pressure.
Capricorn.watch: Carrying too much alone can make support feel suspicious.

Aquarius.summary: Aquarius placements describe a personality that needs perspective and intellectual freedom. You often see the system around the story and are drawn to what could be redesigned.
Aquarius.gift: Independence, invention, and loyalty to the larger pattern.
Aquarius.watch: Detachment can protect you from feelings you still need to feel.

Pisces.summary: Pisces placements describe a personality with a permeable imagination and a deep instinct for atmosphere. You often understand through symbol, music, dreams, and compassion.
Pisces.gift: Sensitivity, forgiveness, and access to subtle forms of knowing.
Pisces.watch: Boundaries are not a failure of love; they are how love stays clear.

elements.Fire: Your chart leans toward ignition: instinct, appetite, courage, and the need to act before the spark cools.
elements.Earth: Your chart leans toward embodiment: patience, craft, pragmatism, and the need to see value take form.
elements.Air: Your chart leans toward cognition: ideas, exchange, perspective, and the need to name what is happening.
elements.Water: Your chart leans toward feeling: memory, intuition, bonding, and the need to honor emotional truth.

modalities.Cardinal: Cardinal emphasis points to an initiator: you get energy from beginning, directing, and setting things in motion.
modalities.Fixed: Fixed emphasis points to a stabilizer: you get energy from loyalty, depth, repetition, and sustained devotion.
modalities.Mutable: Mutable emphasis points to an adapter: you get energy from change, synthesis, learning, and responsive movement.

planets.Mercury: Mercury visible above the horizon adds an outward mental signature: words, curiosity, and quick noticing want expression.
planets.Venus: Venus visible above the horizon emphasizes attraction, style, social warmth, and the instinct to harmonize.
planets.Mars: Mars visible above the horizon sharpens drive, heat, appetite, and the courage to pursue what matters.
planets.Jupiter: Jupiter visible above the horizon broadens confidence, faith, humor, and the search for generous meaning.
planets.Saturn: Saturn visible above the horizon brings seriousness, self-command, patience, and respect for earned growth.
planets.Uranus: Uranus visible above the horizon adds independence, experiment, disruption, and a refusal to live only by precedent.
planets.Neptune: Neptune visible above the horizon heightens imagination, longing, sensitivity, and symbolic perception.

moonPhases.New Moon: A New Moon birth often describes a seed-stage temperament: instinctive, self-renewing, and pulled toward beginnings.
moonPhases.Waxing Crescent: A Waxing Crescent birth often describes a builder of faith: learning to trust an inner direction before it is fully visible.
moonPhases.First Quarter: A First Quarter birth often describes a decisive temperament: growth comes through action, friction, and choice.
moonPhases.Waxing Gibbous: A Waxing Gibbous birth often describes a refining temperament: improvement, service, and preparation matter.
moonPhases.Full Moon: A Full Moon birth often describes a relational temperament: awareness grows through reflection, contrast, and encounter.
moonPhases.Waning Gibbous: A Waning Gibbous birth often describes a teaching temperament: experience wants to be shared, interpreted, or offered.
moonPhases.Last Quarter: A Last Quarter birth often describes a questioning temperament: inherited patterns are tested against lived truth.
moonPhases.Waning Crescent: A Waning Crescent birth often describes an old-soul temperament: private integration, endings, and quiet wisdom are emphasized.
